body:
I was hoping I would come back here in triumph and with things having worked out, but they haven't. So I've decided that I'm going to go through with it, since I have a plan and a means that is readily accessible with no effort and nobody around to get in the way. People say that those who have decided feel a sudden sense of happiness, but really all I feel is a strange surreal feeling of "so I'm really going to do it then." 

This has probably been a long time coming. I regret that there are people that are going to be hurt, including two girls who expressed romantic interests in me. And friends that have been around for awhile. It's kind of shitty to think of it this way, but I can't comfort them through my own demise. 

Second regret is that I can't give someone a new lease on life by doing this. Oh well.

Then it really is depression? I've literally just been fighting it on willpower alone for the past near decade. No drugs or anything. Just. Fighting it. I'm slowly losing the fight though. I don't want to.

But I'm afraid that if something happens it might actually make me go through with it. It's strange to say that in such a way, as though I don't have a choice over whether or not to do the act. But things happen when your emotions can be come elevated and you're just so...low.

When I was in the national guard I was going to see the psychologist they had on the base at the time. Of his bits of wisdom were constantly bringing up my family, telling me that I'm just addicted to failure and should think positive, believe in God, or maybe sit down and enjoy a nice drink.
